translations.web: He has sent redemption to his people. He has ordained his covenant forever. His name is holy and awesome!
translations.bsb: He has sent redemption to His people; He has ordained His covenant forever; holy and awesome is His name.
translations.kjv: He sent redemption unto his people: he hath commanded his covenant for ever: holy and reverend is his name.
